questions.prompt: Why can pi run DeepSeek with so little code?
options: DeepSeek is a copy of an Anthropic model
DeepSeek speaks the OpenAI-compatible chat format, so pi reuses that adapter
The loop has a special DeepSeek branch
The key is stored inside the model file
questions.explanation: The definition sets api: openAICompletionsApi(). The adapter for that format already exists, so DeepSeek needs only its id, address, key and models.

questions.prompt: You run pi --model deepseek/deepseek-flash:high. What does high set?
options: The maximum number of tool calls
The size of the context window
questions.explanation: The suffix after the colon is the thinking level, which says how much the model reasons before it answers.

questions.prompt: A model does not support the thinking level you choose. What does pi do?
options: It rounds to the nearest level the model supports
It asks the model to choose
questions.explanation: Each model maps levels to its own values, and unsupported levels are rounded to the nearest supported one.
